package store_test

import (
	"context"

func TestDemoSeedUsesDeploymentAuthenticationPolicy(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	p := &profile.Profile{
		Demo:   true,
		Data:   t.TempDir(),
		Driver: "sqlite",
		DSN:    filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "demo.db"),
	}
	driver, err := sqlite.NewDB(p)
	require.NoError(t, err)
